title: From transcription to semantic corpus analysis: unsupervised learning of sentence representations for ancient languages
abstract: arXiv:2607.24542v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automatic Text Recognition (ATR) now supplies digital humanities with large volumes of unstruc- tured, heterogeneous, and often noisy text in ancient languages. Downstream semantic analyses- text reuse identification, alignment, and semantic search-rely on sentence embeddings, yet ex- isting methods transfer poorly to ancient languages: generic multilingual encoders underperform, specialized language models yield anisotropic representation spaces, and labeled similarity data is scarce. We study two fully unsupervised strategies-TSDAE and unsupervised SimCSE (hence- forth CSE)-that adapt a specialized token-level language model into a corpus-specific sentence encoder using only raw sentences. We validate them on biblical reuse in patristic literature in Latin and Ancient Greek: 2,936 sentences carrying expert-verified reuses in works of Augustine, Jerome, and Athanasius, matched against the Vulgate, the Septuagint, and the Nestle--Ala

translated_title: 从转录到语义语料库分析：面向古代语言的无监督句子表示学习
translated_abstract: 自动文本识别（ATR）如今为数字人文领域提供了大量非结构化、异构且常含噪声的古代语言文本。下游的语义分析——如文本复用识别、对齐和语义检索——依赖于句子嵌入，然而现有方法向古代语言的迁移效果不佳：通用多语言编码器表现欠佳，专用语言模型产生各向异性的表示空间，且标注的相似度数据十分稀缺。我们研究了两种完全无监督的策略——TSDAE 和无监督 SimCSE（以下简称 CSE）——它们仅利用原始句子，将专用的词元级语言模型适配为面向特定语料库的句子编码器。我们在拉丁语和古希腊语教父文献中的圣经文本复用任务上对这两种方法进行了验证：语料包含奥古斯丁、哲罗姆和阿塔纳修斯著作中 2,936 个经专家验证含有圣经复用的句子，并与《武加大译本》、《七十士译本》以及 Nestle-Aland 版本文本进行匹配。
tldr: 本文提出两种完全无监督的方法（TSDAE 和无监督 SimCSE），仅用原始句子将面向古代语言的专用词元级语言模型转化为语料库专属的句子编码器，并在拉丁语和古希腊语教父文献中经专家验证的圣经文本复用识别任务上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two fully unsupervised strategies (TSDAE and unsupervised SimCSE) that adapt a specialized token-level language model for ancient languages into corpus-specific sentence encoders using only raw sentences, validated on expert-verified biblical text reuse in Latin and Ancient Greek patristic literature.
